the weekly bullish reactivation was confirmed with room to spare today (new weekly high 93.14) after a violent round-trip, but with no catalyst of its own (the EIA already happened yesterday, the next one is next week). The only instrument without an extreme stretch tonight, closing glued to POC/VWAP (91.53-91.60) -- the cleanest read in the complex if it defends that zone and reclaims 91.75-92.29. Tomorrow Friday brings NFP at 07:30 CT (outside Asia, inside NY), treat the whole day with extra caution.

London Update 01:34 CT: Asia attempted the 91.75-92.29 reclaim (reached 92.17) but didn't hold, fell back to 91.40 and drbias flipped to NO BIAS. London plan: WAIT, requires a clean confirmed reclaim above 91.75 or a clear break of 90.97 before redefining. Remaining range ~2.24pts (72% of budget).

[NY Update 08:10 CT -- see Spanish text above for full detail; short version:] The 91.75-92.29 reclaim was never retried in London; post-NFP dollar strength sank it to the overnight low 89.91, under 1pt from the weekly invalidation 89.04; no-man's-land, no bullish FVG; AVOID, no conviction read.
